ablation.name: semantic_local_adain
ablation.notes: Round10: Semantic Local AdaIN. Uses LL_c/LL_s as semantic descriptors to compute per-position style stats via softmax attention. Solves global AdaIN washout: sky gets sky's covariance, trees get trees'. alpha=0.5, tau=0.1. Target: break DINO-S>0.4859 while keeping CLIP-S>=0.7075, DINO-C>=0.82, LPIPS<=0.27.
